title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Tuesday 24 November, 5:53pm.** The three standouts right now: the **AirPods Pro 3 at £165** at Amazon (still their lowest ever), the new **Kindle (2026) at a record-low £119.99** at Amazon, and the **Ring Battery Doorbell plus Indoor Camera for £39.99** at Amazon.

Black Friday is three days away, on Friday 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. This evening we added the Kindle, Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 (£126, lowest ever), reMarkable 2 bundle (£399, record low), Oral-B iO3 (£49.99), Bose QuietComfort Earbuds (£99), Fire TV Stick 4K (£31.99), the Switch 2 Sports Resort bundle (£399), Lego Game Boy (£35.99) and a Ninja StaySharp knife block (£109.99), all at Amazon. We took off deals we couldn't re-confirm in the last two days (Kindle Paperwhite Signature, Sonos Ace, Dyson Clean+Wash, Blink camera, Ninja AF300UK) plus a few weaker ones. **PS5 buyers:** consoles are in short supply since GTA VI launched; see our [PS5 guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/) before paying a reseller's price. Prices were reported on 23 and 24 November, so check the retailer's page before you buy. Many Amazon prices need Prime: a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole sale.

deals.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
deals.note: Still £165 at Amazon on 24 November (T3) and 23 November (Macworld): the lowest UK price yet. The AirPods most people should buy.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (2026, 16GB)
deals.note: A record low for the newest basic Kindle, £119.99 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar). Glare-free screen, adjustable light and weeks of battery. Add a [Kindle Unlimited trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) for free books, and see our [Kindle guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A wire-free doorbell plus a plug-in indoor camera for about what the doorbell alone usually costs; still £39.99 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar). The 'was' price adds the two list prices together, but £40 for both is excellent. See our [Ring doorbell guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: TCL P8L 65-inch Mini LED 4K TV
deals.note: £150 off at Amazon (What Hi-Fi, 24 November), and a What Hi-Fi? Award winner this year. Mini LED brightness for under £700 is the best-value big TV deal we've seen this week.

deals.name: Apple Watch Ultra 3 (49mm, Ocean Band)
deals.note: Over £250 off at Argos (TechRadar, 23 November), a rare cut for Apple's top watch. Amazon isn't matching it yet, so Argos is the one to use. Still £495 at Argos on 23 November (TechRadar). Amazon doesn't match it yet; use the compare link to check.

deals.name: JBL Live 780NC Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
deals.note: A new low of £99 at Amazon on 23 November (What Hi-Fi), £71 off. Big, comfortable over-ears with decent noise cancelling for well under half the price of a Sony or Bose.

deals.name: Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 Bone Conduction Headphones
deals.note: Their lowest price yet, £126 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar). Open-ear headphones that leave you able to hear traffic, the ones most runners and cyclists want. See [gifts for runners](/guides/gifts-for-runners-uk/).

deals.name: reMarkable 2 with Marker Plus and Book Folio
deals.note: A record-low £399 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar) for the paper-feel writing tablet with the eraser pen and a folio case. For note-takers and students; for reading, a Kindle is far cheaper.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Colorsoft (16GB)
deals.note: Amazon's colour-screen Kindle, great for comics, cookbooks and highlighting. TechRadar lists it at £144.99 today, and Which?'s price data puts that at its cheapest ever. A [Kindle Unlimited trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) adds free books. See our [Kindle guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: £49.99 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar). The 'was' price is the list price it rarely sells at, but under £50 for an iO brush with a pressure sensor is very good. See our [Oral-B guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer
deals.note: £99 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar), under last year's Black Friday price of £117. Cooks in glass dishes you can serve from and store leftovers in. Good for one or two people.

deals.name: Amazon Ember 50-inch 4-Series 4K TV
deals.note: A lowest-ever £269.99 at Amazon, re-confirmed on 24 November (TechRadar). A 50-inch 4K TV with Fire TV built in for a bedroom or kitchen. See our [TV guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Bose QuietComfort Earbuds
deals.note: £99 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar), with some colours at a record low. Strong noise cancelling for well under AirPods Pro money.

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K
deals.note: The lowest price it has been, £31.99 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar). Turns any TV with an HDMI port into a smart TV; an easy gift.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Origin Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Dyson's cheapest current cordless at £130 off, still in Amazon's Black Friday picks this morning (20 November). Fine for flats and quick tidy-ups. More in our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/). Re-confirmed on 23 November (afternoon).

deals.name: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones
deals.note: About £150 off at Amazon (T3, 23 November). Bose's best noise cancelling; pick these over the Sony XM5 if comfort on long flights matters most.

deals.name: Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: Philips' premium sonic brush with app tracking and a charging glass. TechRadar reports £109.99 at Amazon today, a record low. See our [Oral-B guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/) if you prefer a rotating head.

deals.name: Sony PS-LX3BT Bluetooth Turntable
deals.note: £100 off at Amazon (What Hi-Fi, 24 November). Plays records through Bluetooth speakers or headphones as well as a normal hi-fi, so it's an easy Christmas present for a new vinyl fan.

deals.name: Nintendo Switch 2 + Switch Sports Resort bundle
deals.note: £399 at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar): the console plus a game for less than the two separately. Console discounts are rare, so this is the one to buy. See our [Switch 2 guide](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm)
deals.note: £484.99 at Amazon on 23 November (T3), £215 off and within a few pounds of the lowest price we've seen (£479.99 this morning). Prices on this one have moved several times this week, so check before you buy.

deals.name: LEGO Game Boy (72046)
deals.note: £19 off at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar). A life-size brick Game Boy for adult fans and retro gamers; see [Lego gifts for adults](/guides/lego-gifts-for-adults-uk/).

deals.name: Ninja Foodi StaySharp Knife Block
deals.note: £70 off at Amazon on 24 November (TechRadar). The block has a built-in sharpener, so the knives stay sharp without any effort. A good gift for [people who love cooking](/guides/gifts-for-people-who-love-cooking-uk/).

deals.name: Apple AirTag (2nd gen) 4-pack
deals.note: £18.50 a tag (Macworld, prices checked 23 November), a little up on the weekend's £71.78 but still £25 off. An easy stocking filler for keys, bags and suitcases.

deals.name: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless Headphones
deals.note: Back to their lowest price, £25 at Amazon on 23 November (What Hi-Fi). No noise cancelling, but 50-hour battery and light enough for kids or the commute. An easy stocking filler.

deals.name: LEGO Classic Large Creative Brick Box (10698)
deals.note: £28.99 at Amazon, re-confirmed on 24 November (TechRadar). 790 bricks with ideas booklets, an easy gift for almost any age from 4 up. See our [Lego guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Tech

Amazon's own devices lead again: the new Kindle is a record-low £119.99, the Kindle Colorsoft is £144.99, the Fire TV Stick 4K is its cheapest yet at £31.99 and the Ring doorbell bundle is £39.99. For Apple, the AirPods Pro 3 are still £165, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 is £495 at Argos (over £250 off) and a 4-pack of AirTags is £74. The reMarkable 2 writing tablet bundle is a record-low £399, and the Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm) is £484.99.

For audio, the JBL Live 780NC are a record-low £99, the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 are their lowest yet at £126, the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds are £99, the Bose QuietComfort Ultra headphones £298.79, and Sony's WH-CH520 are £25 for a cheap commuting or kids' pair. Sony's PS-LX3BT turntable is £199. For TVs, the TCL P8L 65-inch Mini LED is £699 and the Amazon Ember 50-inch £269.99. Gamers: the Switch 2 with Switch Sports Resort is £399, and PS5 consoles are hard to find at the normal price.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Apple Watch](/guides/apple-watch-deals-uk/), [Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

The Ninja Crispi glass air fryer is £99, below last year's Black Friday price, and the Ninja StaySharp knife block is £70 off at £109.99. The Dyson V8 Origin at £199.99 is the standout cordless vacuum deal. We've taken the Ninja AF300UK dual-zone off until we can re-confirm its price; TechRadar says it's at its lowest of the year at Amazon.

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

Electric toothbrushes are the best beauty deals today: the Oral-B iO Series 3 is £49.99 and the Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 £109.99, both at Amazon. For hair, the Dyson Airwrap Origin is down to £279 at AO (£299 at Amazon) and the Airwrap i.d. is £369 at Amazon; see our [Dyson Airwrap price guide](/guides/dyson-airwrap-deals-uk/). For fragrance gifts, [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those now. The Lego Classic Large Creative Brick Box is £28.99 at Amazon, an easy gift for almost any age, and the Lego Game Boy is £35.99 for adult fans. For readers, an [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December and can be given as a gift. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/), [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', it's already at or below last year's Black Friday price, so buy it. Items marked 'Good price' could still fall a little in the final week.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices to wait for.
